briefdescription.para: Runs a self-test on the timebase or window if enabled.

detaileddescription.para: Timebase test verifies that the timebase is incrementing. The watchdog timer is not tested due to the time required to wait for the watchdog timer to expire. The time consumed by this test is dependent on the system clock and the configuration of the dividers for the input clock of the timebase.
Window test verifies that the windowing feature does not generate bad event after enabling window feature with first and second window count. It disables window feature immediately.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the XWdtTb instance to be worked on.

listitem.para: XST_WDTTB_TIMER_FAILED if the timebase is not incrementing.

briefdescription.para: Implements the self-test function of the XWdtTb driver.

detaileddescription.para: The xwdttb_selftest.c file contains diagnostic self-test functions for the XWdtTb component.
